All international application materials must be submitted by May 1 for fall admission

gre_general.value: GRE is required when the degree is from an institution not accredited by a US regional agency; the department may waive it for a last-degree GPA of 3.5 or more or two years of US engineering work.
gre_general.quote: Applicants must submit official scores from the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) if they graduated from an institution not accredited by a regional accrediting agency of the USA

also.quote: Applicant’s overall GPA from last degree is at least 3.5 on a 4.0 scale

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Admission is by committee; you find a faculty advisor after you join, and your statement should name matching faculty.
supervisor.quote: Finding a faculty advisor is one of the first required tasks in the program

entry_route.value: A master's from an accredited institution is normally required; strong undergraduates can apply straight to the PhD.

also.quote: students with outstanding undergraduate records may apply directly for admission to the doctoral program
